question: Braves vs. White Sox — Who wins? (Aug 20)

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Atlanta Braves": Wins if the Atlanta Braves are the official winner of the MLB game between the Atlanta Braves and the Chicago White Sox played on August 20, 2026 (UTC).
- "Chicago White Sox": Wins if the Chicago White Sox are the official winner of the MLB game between the Atlanta Braves and the Chicago White Sox played on August 20, 2026 (UTC).

Clarifications:
- The official final score, including any extra innings or suspended-game completion, determines the winner. If the game is postponed and not completed before the market's settlement time, the market is unresolvable.
